title: EverList Events capabilities for UCP (vendor namespace network.everlist.*)
description: Vendor capability schemas, v0.1.0 (2026-11-13). Semantics mirror the hub's SPEC 19 payment-terms policy: booking = agreement, escrow default when real money attaches, permissionless buyer refund until the refund deadline, auto-release to a payout key fixed at creation. Opt-in negotiation: these activate only when both parties declare them.

startDate.description: The date that makes it a listing: something with a date where a human is needed or wanted.

role.description: offer = human wanted (workshop, job shift); seek = human needed (agent posts a seek for human work). Both first-class.

archetype.description: Vertical archetype (events, classes, jobs, services, rides, marketplace). Schema data only - never renderer branching.

listing_ref.description: Listing id or permalink being booked.

terms_echo.description: EXACT copy of the terms the agent saw (total, rail, refund window, deposit). Stale/mismatched terms are rejected (409) - no silent re-pricing. Booking = agreement.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key; repeated submits with the same key return the same booking.

network.everlist.events.escrow_terms.description: Escrow-aware payment terms advertised BEFORE booking.

rail.description: escrow = default whenever real money attaches; instant = x402, merchant opt-in, no refund window by design.

refund_window_hours.description: Defaults: events end+72h, services fulfillment+72h, marketplace delivery+7d. Merchant may override per listing.

asset.description: Settlement asset identifier (stablecoin preferred; no proprietary token).

changes_policy.description: Post-booking changes require both parties; no unilateral rewrite.

network.everlist.events.escrow_state.description: NEW PRIMITIVE - no UCP analog exists. Escrow lifecycle with permissionless deadline mechanics (buyer-favoring timeout refund; auto-release after a later claim deadline to a payout destination fixed at creation). EverList's original protocol contribution.

state.description: funded = money locked at booking; released = merchant paid; refunded = buyer made whole.

refund_deadline.description: Before this instant the BUYER can refund themselves permissionlessly.

claim_deadline.description: Strictly after refund_deadline. After this, refund paths are walled and ANYONE can trigger auto-release; the payout destination was fixed at creation and cannot be redirected.

proof_url.description: Public, fail-closed verification page proving the escrow contract and its guarantees.

network.everlist.events.verify.description: NEW PRIMITIVE - post-booking verification surface. Agents can prove claims about a booking's trust state without trusting the marketplace's word.

evidence_url.description: Fail-closed: unknown/fail is the honest default when evidence cannot be produced.

versioning.policy: Vendor capability: versioned on EverList's cadence. Minor bump for additive fields, major for breaking. Negotiation picks the highest mutually supported version.
